news.titleEn: US Producer Prices Up Most Since 2022 as Energy Pain Worsens
news.conclusionEn: US producer prices jumped 6.3% year over year in September, the biggest annual gain since 2022, far above the 5.5% economists expected.
news.conclusionZh: 美国9月PPI同比涨6.3%，创2022年以来最大涨幅
news.whyEn: A second straight day of hotter-than-expected inflation makes another Fed rate hike this year more likely, pressuring stocks and borrowers.
news.whyZh: 继CPI之后通胀再超预期，美联储年内再加息的可能性大增
news.detailEn: The PPI rose 1.3% month over month, the largest monthly gain since March 2022, while core PPI excluding food and energy rose 0.7% on the month and 5% from a year earlier. Energy was the main driver as the Middle East conflict curtailed oil supply, and nearly half of the rise in processed goods was tied to diesel. Economists say rising energy costs are now feeding into other categories. Coming a day after a hot CPI print, the data strengthens the case that the Fed's tightening is not finished.
news.detailZh: PPI环比上涨1.3%，为2022年3月以来最大月涨幅；剔除食品和能源的核心PPI环比涨0.7%、同比涨5%。中东冲突压缩原油供应，能源是主要推手，加工品涨幅中近一半与柴油涨价有关。经济学家指出，能源成本正在向其他品类传导。紧随前一天CPI超预期之后，这份数据进一步说明美联储的紧缩还没结束。

news.titleEn: Kospi Drops 8% as Samsung, SK Hynix Shares Plunge on AI and Rate Fears
news.conclusionEn: South Korea's Kospi fell nearly 8% into a bear market as Samsung and SK Hynix each dropped more than 9%, deepening a global AI chip sell-off.
news.conclusionZh: 韩国综指暴跌近8%进入熊市，三星和SK海力士均跌超9%
news.whyEn: The world's top memory makers anchor the AI supply chain; the rout signals investors are questioning how the AI build-out will be financed.
news.whyZh: 存储芯片龙头是AI供应链核心，暴跌说明市场开始质疑AI扩张的资金来源
news.detailEn: Korea's exchange halted trading for 20 minutes as selling deepened, and the Kospi is now about 21% below its September high. Hotter US inflation revived fears of Fed tightening, while distress in CoreWeave's debt forced investors to confront the financing bill behind AI infrastructure. Worries about Chinese competition in memory and possible oversupply later in the decade added pressure. Some 20 of the most valuable AI and chip stocks have shed more than $1 trillion in value this week.
news.detailZh: 抛售加剧时韩国交易所暂停交易20分钟，韩国综指已较9月高点下跌约21%。美国通胀超预期重燃加息担忧，CoreWeave的债务困境也让投资者直面AI基建背后的融资成本。对中国存储芯片竞争和未来几年可能供过于求的担忧进一步施压。本周全球市值最高的约20只AI和芯片股合计蒸发超1万亿美元。

news.titleEn: U.S. crude oil near $98 as Iran steps up attacks in Strait of Hormuz
news.conclusionEn: WTI crude rose about 3% to $97.97 a barrel after the US confirmed an Iranian projectile sank a container ship in the Strait of Hormuz.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗加强霍尔木兹海峡袭击，美油涨约3%至近98美元
news.whyEn: Hormuz is the world's key oil chokepoint; higher crude feeds directly into inflation, rate expectations and fuel costs worldwide.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹是全球石油咽喉，油价上涨直接推高通胀和加息预期
news.detailEn: US Central Command confirmed the Singapore-flagged GFS Pride, which sank this week, was struck by an Iranian projectile; all 21 crew were evacuated. More than 20 vessels have been attacked in the region this month. Brent for December settled slightly lower at $105.92, while US crude was also supported by an 8 million-barrel inventory draw. The IEA has warned diesel constraints could last well into next year as fresh attacks on Saudi Arabia threaten supply recovery.
news.detailZh: 美国中央司令部证实，本周沉没的新加坡籍货轮GFS Pride遭伊朗导弹击中，21名船员均已撤离。本月该地区已有20多艘船遭袭。12月布伦特原油小幅收跌至105.92美元，美油还受到800万桶库存降幅的支撑。国际能源署警告，柴油供应紧张可能延续到明年，沙特再遭袭击也威胁供应恢复。

news.titleEn: TSMC posts record profit for a sixth straight quarter, beating estimates on AI boom
news.conclusionEn: TSMC's third-quarter net income rose 68.7% to a record NT$763.1 billion, beating forecasts, and it guided Q4 revenue to $52.3-54.3 billion.
news.conclusionZh: 台积电三季度净利润增68.7%创新高，并上调四季度指引
news.whyEn: As the main maker of AI chips, TSMC's results are a real-time check on AI demand, offering a counterpoint to this week's AI sell-off.
news.whyZh: 台积电是AI芯片核心代工厂，业绩显示AI需求仍强，与本周抛售形成反差
news.detailEn: Revenue reached about NT$1.49 trillion, up 50.9% year over year, with gross margin of 66.4% and operating margin of 58.7%, above the top of guidance. Advanced nodes of 7nm and below made up 79% of wafer revenue, with 2nm already at 8%. The fourth-quarter outlook implies further sequential growth. The results suggest that demand for AI computing remains strong even as markets worry about how AI spending is financed.
news.detailZh: 营收约1.49万亿新台币，同比增长50.9%；毛利率66.4%，营业利润率58.7%，超过指引上限。7纳米及以下先进制程占晶圆营收79%，2纳米已占8%。四季度指引意味着营收还会继续环比增长。业绩表明，尽管市场担忧AI投资的资金来源，AI算力需求本身依然强劲。

news.titleEn: Treasury yields slide as investors flee to safety of bonds amid tech rout
news.conclusionEn: The 10-year Treasury yield fell more than 10 basis points to about 5.09% as investors dumped tech stocks and moved into bonds.
news.conclusionZh: 科技股遭抛售，资金涌入美债，10年期收益率跌超10个基点
news.whyEn: Falling yields lower mortgage and borrowing benchmarks and show money rotating from growth stocks to safety, even with inflation running hot.
news.whyZh: 收益率回落影响房贷等借贷利率，也显示资金从成长股转向避险资产
news.detailEn: The 30-year yield fell more than 9 basis points to around 5.43%. The move came despite the hot PPI report, as fears that higher rates could choke the AI spending boom drove a classic flight to safety. Yields had hit 24-year highs earlier in October. Investors will watch Fed officials' comments for signals on whether another hike comes this month.
news.detailZh: 30年期收益率下跌超9个基点至约5.43%。尽管PPI数据偏热，市场担心高利率会扼杀AI投资热潮，引发典型的避险操作。10月初美债收益率曾创24年新高。投资者将关注美联储官员讲话，判断本月是否会再次加息。

news.titleEn: Anthropic Revenue Hits $16.8 Billion in Quarter Before IPO
news.conclusionEn: Anthropic's third-quarter revenue reached $16.8 billion, up from $11.6 billion in Q2, and it was profitable on an adjusted basis ahead of a planned IPO.
news.conclusionZh: Anthropic三季度营收168亿美元并实现调整后盈利，IPO在即
news.whyEn: It is rare evidence that a leading AI lab can make money, which could shape valuations for the AI sector and one of the year's biggest IPOs.
news.whyZh: 罕见证明头部AI公司能赚钱，将影响AI板块估值和年内最大IPO之一
news.detailEn: The company also reported positive free cash flow and an adjusted gross margin of about 85%. The IPO is reportedly slated for November. Analysts say the results may help the listing but won't necessarily lift the broader AI trade, since strong model makers could squeeze software companies and pressure infrastructure players. The numbers arrive in the middle of a sharp sell-off in AI-linked stocks.
news.detailZh: 公司还实现了正自由现金流，调整后毛利率约85%。据报道其IPO定于11月。分析师认为，这份业绩有利于上市，但未必能带动整个AI板块，因为强势的模型公司可能挤压软件企业和基础设施厂商。这份数据恰好发布于AI概念股大幅下跌期间。

news.titleEn: Ukraine to resume strikes on Russian refineries, shattering hopes of an 'energy ceasefire'
news.conclusionEn: Zelenskyy ordered Ukraine to resume strikes on Russian oil refineries, ending a three-day pause after Russia launched massive attacks on Ukraine's energy grid.
news.conclusionZh: 泽连斯基下令恢复打击俄罗斯炼油厂，「能源停火」希望破灭
news.whyEn: Refinery strikes cut Russian fuel output, adding to an already tight global diesel market and straining US-Ukraine relations.
news.whyZh: 打击炼油厂会减少俄燃油产出，加剧全球柴油紧张，也使美乌关系更紧张
news.detailEn: Zelenskyy said Ukraine honored the proposed energy ceasefire for three days while Russia fired around 40 ballistic missiles and more than 850 drones. Kyiv also accused Washington of restricting its Starlink and Starshield access, cutting warnings of incoming missiles; Elon Musk said such limits are decided by the US government. EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas called the refinery strikes self-defense. The rift complicates US-led peace efforts.
news.detailZh: 泽连斯基称乌克兰遵守了三天的能源停火，而俄方同期发射约40枚弹道导弹和850多架无人机。基辅还指责美方限制其使用星链和星盾，导致失去导弹来袭预警；马斯克称相关限制由美国政府决定。欧盟外交与安全政策高级代表卡拉斯称乌方袭击炼油厂属于自卫。这一分歧让美国主导的和谈更加复杂。

news.titleEn: September producer price index, retail sales data
news.conclusionEn: US retail sales rose 0.8% in September, beating the 0.4% forecast, but sales excluding autos and gas grew only about 0.25%.
news.conclusionZh: 美国9月零售销售增0.8%超预期，但剔除汽车和汽油后明显放缓
news.whyEn: Headline spending is propped up by pricier fuel, while underlying demand is cooling — a warning sign for consumer-facing companies.
news.whyZh: 整体数据被油价推高，核心消费在降温，对消费类企业是警示
news.detailEn: Retail sales slowed from August's gain of more than 1%. The core measure excluding autos and gas stations dropped from around 1.1% to roughly 0.25%, suggesting consumers are cutting back elsewhere to cover fuel costs. Combined with hot inflation data, the report points to a squeeze on household budgets. Economists will watch whether this weakness spreads into the holiday shopping season.
news.detailZh: 零售销售较8月超过1%的增速放缓。剔除汽车和加油站后的核心零售从约1.1%降至约0.25%，说明消费者为负担油费而在其他方面节省开支。结合偏热的通胀数据，家庭预算正受到挤压。经济学家将关注这种疲软是否会蔓延到假日购物季。

news.titleEn: Bending Spoons skyrockets 41% as Berkshire Hathaway makes $330 million investment
news.conclusionEn: Bending Spoons shares jumped 41% after Berkshire Hathaway invested another $330 million, lifting its stake to about 4%.
news.conclusionZh: 伯克希尔再投3.3亿美元，Bending Spoons股价飙升41%
news.whyEn: It is one of the clearest signals of Greg Abel's investing style at Berkshire and a vote of confidence in a tech acquirer amid the tech sell-off.
news.whyZh: 这是阿贝尔掌舵伯克希尔后的明确投资信号，也是科技股下跌中的信心票
news.detailEn: The deal follows a $600 million investment Berkshire made during Bending Spoons' Nasdaq IPO in July. The Milan-based company buys aging but well-known apps and services such as Evernote, Vimeo and Eventbrite and turns them profitable. The fresh capital gives it more firepower for acquisitions. Greg Abel took over as Berkshire CEO from Warren Buffett at the start of the year.
news.detailZh: 此前伯克希尔已在7月Bending Spoons登陆纳斯达克时投资6亿美元。这家米兰公司专门收购Evernote、Vimeo、Eventbrite等老牌但增长停滞的应用，再把它们做到盈利。新资金将增强其并购能力。格雷格·阿贝尔于今年初接替巴菲特出任伯克希尔CEO。

news.titleEn: Netflix to lay off roughly 1,000 employees, or 6% of workforce
news.conclusionEn: Netflix will cut about 1,000 jobs, or 6% of staff, mainly in product, tech, legal and HR teams.
news.conclusionZh: 奈飞将裁员约1000人，占员工总数6%
news.whyEn: The cuts signal slowing growth at the streaming leader days before its Oct. 20 earnings, and reflect wider cost discipline across tech.
news.whyZh: 裁员显示流媒体龙头增长放缓，也反映科技行业普遍收紧成本
news.detailEn: Co-CEOs Ted Sarandos and Greg Peters told staff the business is strong and on track for its full-year forecast, but that the mission requires discipline in prioritizing resources. The move comes weeks after Sarandos said the company was not growing as fast as he wanted. Investors will look for details on growth and spending when Netflix reports quarterly results on Oct. 20.
news.detailZh: 联席CEO萨兰多斯和彼得斯在给员工的邮件中称，公司业务依然强劲、有望完成全年目标，但需要更有纪律地分配资源。几周前萨兰多斯曾表示公司增长「没有我希望的那么快」。奈飞将于10月20日公布季度业绩，投资者将关注增长和支出方面的细节。

businessTips.explanationEn: Zero-based budgeting means building each budget from zero every period, so every expense has to be justified again instead of simply rolling last year's numbers forward. It forces managers to ask whether each cost still serves current priorities. It is useful when conditions change fast, such as when energy or labor costs spike. The trade-off is that it takes more time and effort than incremental budgeting.
businessTips.explanationZh: 零基预算是指每个周期都从零开始编预算，每一笔开支都要重新论证，而不是在去年的数字上简单增减。它迫使管理者追问：这笔钱是否仍服务于当前的重点？在能源、人工等成本快速变化时尤其有用。代价是比增量预算更耗时费力。
businessTips.exampleEn: Like Netflix trimming teams to "prioritize resources", a company might list every department's costs and fund only those tied to this year's goals. A small business could review every subscription and supplier contract each quarter and cancel what no longer pays off.
businessTips.exampleZh: 就像奈飞强调「优先分配资源」而精简团队，公司可以把各部门开支逐项列出，只保留与今年目标挂钩的部分。小企业也可以每季度逐一审查订阅服务和供应商合同，取消已经不划算的项目。

businessTips.explanationEn: Instead of starting from zero, acquisition entrepreneurs buy an existing small business — a website, newsletter, micro-SaaS or local service — that already has customers and cash flow. The goal is to improve operations, pricing or marketing and grow profits. It removes the hardest early-stage risk: finding product-market fit. The key skills are due diligence and avoiding overpaying.
businessTips.explanationZh: 收购型创业不是从零开始，而是买下一个已经有客户和现金流的小生意，比如网站、newsletter、小型SaaS或本地服务。买来之后通过改善运营、定价或营销来提升利润。它绕开了早期最难的一关——验证产品市场匹配。关键能力是尽职调查和不要买贵。
businessTips.exampleEn: Bending Spoons built a $25B-plus company by buying stagnant apps like Evernote and making them profitable. On a side-hustle scale, you might buy a niche website earning $500 a month for about 30 times monthly profit, then refresh its content and add new revenue streams.
businessTips.exampleZh: Bending Spoons就是靠收购Evernote等停滞的应用并扭亏为盈，做成了市值超250亿美元的公司。放在副业层面，你可以用约30倍月利润的价格买下一个月赚500美元的小众网站，再通过更新内容、增加变现渠道提升收入。

businessTips.explanationEn: A flight to quality happens when investors sell risky assets like growth stocks and buy safer ones like government bonds, gold or cash. Heavy demand for bonds pushes their prices up and yields down, even if inflation is high. It shows investors care more about protecting capital than chasing returns. Recognizing it helps you understand why stocks and bonds sometimes move in opposite directions.
businessTips.explanationZh: 避险转移是指投资者卖出成长股等高风险资产，买入国债、黄金或现金等更安全的资产。大量资金涌入债券会推高债价、压低收益率，即使通胀仍然偏高。它说明投资者此时更在意保住本金而不是追求回报。理解这一点，有助于明白股债为什么有时会反向波动。
businessTips.exampleEn: On Oct. 15 the 10-year Treasury yield fell more than 10 basis points while chip stocks slumped and gold miners jumped over 4%. Holding some bonds or gold alongside stocks can cushion a portfolio in such sell-offs.
businessTips.exampleZh: 10月15日芯片股大跌，同时10年期美债收益率下跌超10个基点，金矿股上涨逾4%。在股票之外配置一部分债券或黄金，可以在这类抛售中为组合提供缓冲。
